summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of the redesigned Forehand Lab (7-frame sequence). Verified home hero + Explore Techniques nav to /forehand, all 7 filmstrip thumbnails, per-phase hotspot sets (Ready = head/shoulder/racquet/knee/feet only; Contact = head/wrist/racquet/contact_point only), hotspot + chip selection updates coaching panel heading, Prev/Next/Play Sequence auto-advance from Ready through Recovery then stops with button toggling back to Play Sequence, Pause label appears during playback, Slow/Normal speed selector highlights, UTR level selector correctly controls number of coaching blocks (utr12=2, utr24=3, utr46=4) without changing images, save-drill-btn triggers 'Saved to practice list' toast, no artificial timestamps rendered, mobile 390px layout still shows filmstrip. 52/52 real assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Forehand.jsx: PHASES/HOTSPOT_META coupling relies on every phase hotspot id existing in HOTSPOT_META; a typo would crash via meta.label. Consider a safe fallback (meta?.label ?? id).
SPEEDS constants only expose slow/normal; UI advertises just those two which matches — fine. If a 'fast' option is ever added it must be added in both places.
PhaseImage: when a real src is provided, the placeholder testid is skipped — tests keyed on phase-placeholder-<id> will need to switch to phase-image-<id>. Consider a stable testid on both branches.
getCoaching returns generic placeholders keyed only by part/level; final wiring per phase+part is still TODO (already documented).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign verified end-to-end via Playwright on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Key checks confirmed: (1) per-phase hotspot filtering works (Ready and Contact sets validated exactly); (2) UTR level controls only coaching block count (2/3/4) with images/placeholders unchanged; (3) Play Sequence auto-advances then stops at Recovery and button label returns to 'Play Sequence'; (4) No '+0.24s' or similar timestamp anywhere. Images are still null placeholders (labelled slots render as intended).
